description: Add Contacts to a List - Add multiple contacts to an existing list. Recipients are the contacts the account holder supplies. Blocklist and unsubscribes are always enforced. Every call must include source (csv_upload, crm_import, lead_database, form_signup, existing_customer or event_attendee) and source_reference (where the contacts came from: the file name, CRM, lead database export, form or event); calls without them are rejected. Both are stored on new contacts; a contact already in the list is updated and keeps its original source. If the list is used by an active sequence that takes new contacts, new contacts are scheduled into it automatically. Contacts are supplied by the account holder, e.g. from a file, a CRM or a lead database export such as Apollo or ZoomInfo. All contact field names use snake_case (e.g. first_name, last_name, email, phone, company_name, job_title, lead_score). Custom snake_case fields are added to the list's columns. The `starred` boolean is a contact setting and is not added as a list column. Contact archiving is handled by archive_contact.

contacts.description: Array of contact objects to add (max 500). All field names must be snake_case; additional custom snake_case fields are allowed. Include only the fields needed for outreach.

starred.description: Mark/unmark the contact as starred. This is a contact setting, not a data field/column.

list_id.description: The list ID to add contacts to

remove_duplicates.description: Automatically remove duplicate emails from the list

source.description: REQUIRED. Where these contacts came from. lead_database: an export from a B2B data provider such as Apollo or ZoomInfo that the account holder is licensed to use.

source_reference.description: REQUIRED. Where the contacts came from: the file name, CRM, lead database export (e.g. 'Apollo export'), form or event. Describes the actual source.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: add_contacts

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Add Contacts
